page_title: RBL 2-1 AUG | RB Leipzig v Augsburg 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Martin Petersen has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+5' Here is a change. Yan Diomande is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
90+2' 2 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Arthur Chaves (Augsburg), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the left post of his own goal.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
89' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:7.
88' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

87' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Finn Dahmen guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
85' Substitution. Rodrigo Ribeiro is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg).
84' Manuel Baum decides to make a substitution. Noahkai Banks will be replaced by Tim Schnitzer (Augsburg).
84' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

84' OFF THE POST! Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
82' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
78' The main referee, Martin Petersen, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is given a yellow card for dissent.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kristijan Jakic will be replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
76' 1 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
76' The attendance for today's match is 41563.
76' Neat link-up play between Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) and Johan Bakayoko, but Finn Dahmen reads the game well and the move breaks down.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ridle Baku trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
74' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Romulo Cardoso and he is replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
72' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
72' A substitution has been made. Robin Fellhauer is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
70' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
68' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
68' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
66' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
66' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will deliver the corner kick.
65' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
64' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) replaces Brajan Gruda.
61' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Antonio Nusa is replaced by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig).
61' Augsburg get a corner.
60' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag and Augsburg will take a corner.

60' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Maarten Vandevoordt is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
57' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
57' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) prepares to take a corner kick.
57' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
56' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) tries to head the ball into the goal, but his effort is not as powerful as he would have liked and the goalkeeper is able to make an easy save.
55' The foul by Anton Kade (Augsburg) was seen by Martin Petersen who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
54' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
52' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
52' The referee awards a corner and David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.

50' Finn Dahmen makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the top of the net.
50' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
49' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
46' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) steps up to send the ball in.
46' Manuel Baum makes a half-time substitution. Anton Kade (Augsburg) comes on in place of Mert Komur.
46' The whistle blows and Martin Petersen starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+2' The cross into the penalty area from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
45+2' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+1' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+1' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

44' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate at all and goes well over the bar.

43' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Martin Petersen blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
42' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
39' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Fabian Rieder tees up Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Maarten Vandevoordt.
38' Wasted effort! David Raum (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
38' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
37' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
36' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) has again attempted to split the opposition's defence with a through pass.
35' Great teamplay by RB Leipzig as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
31' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
30' There's an opportunity for David Raum (RB Leipzig) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

29' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig. Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.

28' David Raum (RB Leipzig) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
26' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

25' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

23' Maarten Vandevoordt anticipates the direction of the penalty by Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
23' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
22' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
21' Referee Martin Petersen makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
20' Mert Komur (Augsburg) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
19' A dangerous looking corner kick from Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) is cleared to safety by the defence.

19' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
17' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
16' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
15' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
13' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
12' The ball is cleared after Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Maarten Vandevoordt (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

5' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches past the right post!
4' Some great controlled play and passing from RB Leipzig. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' A pass from Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
2' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) will take the corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will supervise the game today.
